terra.problem: This explanation repeats nearly the same wording and structure as the explanation for the battle answer. Each explanation should sound natural and different from the others.
Saying the whole project was waiting for the glory adds a purpose the passage does not state. The guess that Moses stood there taking it in also invents an action the text does not give.
The guess that everybody kept an eye on the cloud adds an action the passage does not give. It says the cloud was in sight of all Israel, not that everyone watched it.
